jobs.brief: Cross-section of a four-floor research house plus roof desk, parlor and basement vault. Each floor: one line of the family. Ten researchers working, every silhouette clearly a different person (height, build, hair, age, tools, one wheelchair user, one child runner). Warm lamp light, archive boxes, census ledgers, a tea set in the parlor. Labelled as THYLORA world characters.
